ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left of the figure is an aromatic six-membered ring; the upper right of this ring is connected to an oxygen atom, and the oxygen is then connected to a carbonyl-containing fragment on the right. On the right, a C=O carbonyl, a downward-extending carbon chain/cyclic connection, and a lower carbon bearing R and OH can be seen. There are also multiple curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning and counting: First count the heavy-atom bonds of the aromatic six-membered ring itself, 6 in total. Then count the non-hydrogen bonds on the right side and in the connecting part: aryl ring-O 1 bond, O-C(=O) 1 bond, C=O 1 bond, C(=O)-C 1 bond, the C-C from that carbon to the lower alcohol carbon 1 bond, lower alcohol carbon-aryl ring 1 bond, lower alcohol carbon-O 1 bond, 7 in total. Exclude the O-H bond and do not expand the R group. The total is 6 + 7 = 13.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a left aromatic six-membered ring is attached through oxygen to a carbonyl-containing fragment, with a lower carbon bearing OH and R; curved arrows are present but are to be ignored. Count the six heavy-atom bonds forming the aromatic ring. Then count the explicit non-H bonds in the right-hand fragment and linkages: aryl–O, O–C(=O), C=O, C(=O)–C, C–C to the lower carbinol carbon, carbinol C–aryl, and carbinol C–O. Exclude the O–H bond and do not expand R. Sum the subtotals to obtain 13.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个芳香六元环；该环右上方连接到一个氧原子，氧再连接到右侧含羰基的片段。右侧可以看到一个 C=O 羰基、一个向下延伸的碳链/环状连接，以及下方带有 R 和 OH 的碳。图中还有多条弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理计数：先数左侧芳香六元环本身的重原子键，共 6 条。再数右侧及连接部分的非氢键：芳环–O 1 条，O–C(=O) 1 条，C=O 1 条，C(=O)–C 1 条，该碳到下方醇碳的 C–C 1 条，下方醇碳–芳环 1 条，下方醇碳–O 1 条，共 7 条。排除 O–H 键，不展开 R 基团。总数为 6 + 7 = 13。

Add the visual subtotals: 6 ring bonds + 7 outside-ring heavy-atom bonds = 13.

method.method_draft: Represent the structure as a heavy-atom graph. Enter the six arene edges A1–A2, A2–A3, A3–A4, A4–A5, A5–A6, and A6–A1. Then enter the seven non-arene explicit edges visible in the transition-state skeleton: A3–Oe, Oe–Cc, Cc–Oc, Cc–Ca, Ca–Cb, Cb–A4, and Cb–Oh. Count each listed edge once and exclude any bond to hydrogen or arrow mark. The graph has 6 + 7 = 13 heavy-atom bonds.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个芳环，显示为六元苯环骨架；芳环右侧连接到一个含氧的过渡态骨架。可见的非氢重原子连接包括芳环上的一个碳连到上方的醚氧 O，醚氧连到右侧羰基碳，羰基碳连到羰基氧，同时羰基碳连到下方碳链；下方碳链再连到芳环另一个碳，并连有一个 OH。图中的弯箭头只是电子移动箭头，不作为键计数。
推理：按指定方法把结构表示为重原子图。芳环有 6 条环边：A1–A2、A2–A3、A3–A4、A4–A5、A5–A6、A6–A1。非芳环的可见重原子边有 7 条：A3–Oe、Oe–Cc、Cc–Oc、Cc–Ca、Ca–Cb、Cb–A4、Cb–Oh。排除所有涉及氢的键并忽略箭头后，总重原子键数为 6 + 7 = 13。
